parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value on your client for each request. The **ClientToken** can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: ServiceInstanceId
parameters.description:
The service instance ID.

Call [ListServiceInstances](~~396200~~) to obtain the service instance ID.
